title: THE LOOP
rule: the first thing on the page is the work happening: a real care screen fills itself from its own capture, gets 'Checks passed', then 'Approved'; every later section is a real screen or a real line of text from the repos
description: Round-12 draft from RESEARCH 4a (H3) and STORY.md. Near-black ground, one amber accent, Public Sans in two sizes on the first screen. Hero: the care calendar builds itself in about 3 s from appointments-week.webp (shell, grid, 23 events, the time line), then two stamps; one line under it: 'AI agents build inside tested rules. A person approves every change.' Then four steps light up while the finished screen stays pinned; a ring of five stations runs one real day (11:37 to 15:40) with real text per station and the way back from Checks; Design System v2 (41 / 868 / 22 / 96.6%) with the real Storybook, status badges and the expected/actual/diff check; four phone apps 2-up on dark cards; Incentiv sign-in; seven own projects; a breadth table. Care case at /drafts/the-loop/care-platform.
signature: Ground #0b0c0f, cards #15171c, ink #f2f3f5 / #b4b8c1 / #959aa4, accent #ffb547; green and red only for pass and fail. Public Sans 60 / 16 on the first screen; Gentrit Technical Mono 14 for real text from the repos. Motion: CSS keyframes on clip-path, transform and opacity only; the ring dot is one WAAPI rotation; arrivals by IntersectionObserver.
holdback: First build of round 12. See SPEC.md 'Open items'.
